About This Item

The ETHOS Rubber Hex Dumbbell is the ideal workout tool for all your cardio and weight training needs. Turn up the level of intensity with this dumbbell, and focus on smaller muscle groups for greater definition. The Rubber coated weights are meant to reduce noise, protect floors and keep your dumbbells working for you longer, delivering solid performance. Increase your daily cardio on the go or at home with the ETHOS Rubber Hex Dumbbell.

Engineered to Last

Built to endure, the ETHOS Rubber Hex Dumbbell features a durable PVC coating. The ergonomic handle with medium-grade knurling provides a secure grip, ensuring comfort and control throughout every workout. Steel heads are sonic welded to the steel handle for maximum durability. 

Limited Lifetime Warranty

Backed by a Limited Lifetime Warranty, ETHOS Rubber Hex Dumbbells are designed to deliver long-lasting performance, giving you confidence in your investment for years to come.

Customers Say

The Ethos Rubber Hex Dumbbells are generally well-received as a high-quality and durable home gym product. Customers praise the great grip, balance, and overall construction, with the rubber coating noted as comfortable and protective of floors. Many find the dumbbells effective for home workouts. However, some customers have experienced issues with the paint, reporting it can be sticky, bleed, or flake off. Overall, the dumbbells appear to be a solid choice for building a home gym setup, with the majority of customers highly recommending the product for its quality and performance.
